note: ADR-0016: the model may name Neon Auth only once ADR-0020 is Accepted. After that, add these to architecture/calm/moments/part-04.architecture.json (node, relationship) and content/architecture/part-04.json (node, edge), then run pnpm check:arch.

calm-node.name: Neon Auth
calm-node.description: Neon's managed sign-in, enabled on the production branch with GitHub as its only provider. The trading app checks the access token it issues against its public keys and stores only the user's id.

calm-relationship.description: The trading app sends a visitor to GitHub through Neon Auth's proxy, reads the session, and fetches the project's public keys to check an access token.

bullpen:rate.basis: No production traffic exists yet; this shows that the edge is used, not how much.
